## Description

Triple C Cattle Ranch represents the pinnacle of East Texas ranch living - a 79-acre property offering operational cattle ranching with luxury living. This turnkey property offers everything serious ranchers, and families seeking the authentic Texas lifestyle want, all within minutes of Carthage, Texas, and its amenities, and less than 3 hours from major metropolitan cities areas.

Key Investment Highlights:

• Prime East Texas location
• Fully operational cattle infrastructure
• Luxury hilltop residence
• Immediate income potential
• Exceptional recreational amenities

Turnkey Cattle Operation &amp; Luxury Estate Home
Prime East Texas Cattle Country
Triple C Cattle Ranch sits in the heart of Panola County's renowned cattle country, where rolling pastures and ancient oak trees create the perfect environment for livestock operations. The property's 79 acres of lush, fenced and cross-fenced pastures provide ideal grazing conditions in East Texas's favorable climate, supporting year-round cattle operations with minimal supplemental feeding required.

Operational Infrastructure:

Working cattle pens with squeeze chute - ready for immediate operations
Hay barn and covered equipment storage for tractors and implements
Small livestock watering lake plus seasonal creek for abundant water sources
Cross-fenced pasture system optimizing grazing rotation
Paved driveway access throughout the property
Luxury Hilltop Ranch Home
The property's crown jewel is a 3,186-square-foot, two-story ranch home, strategically positioned on a hilltop for commanding views of the entire operation. Surrounded by massive ancient oak trees, this residence combines cowboy luxe with modern comfort.

Home Features:

4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms with flexible spaces for large families or guests
Family room with fireplace insert for cozy East Texas evenings
Country kitchen, formal dining room, and sunroom perfect for entertaining
Game room and office/library space providing work-from-home flexibility
Massive tinted windows showcasing panoramic ranch views
Wraparound deck and shaded front porch for outdoor relaxation
Climate-controlled comfort throughout
Resort-Style Outdoor Entertainment Complex
What sets Triple C Ranch apart is its spectacular outdoor entertainment area, which rivals that of high-end resorts. The centerpiece is a professional-grade gunite saltwater pool featuring flowing water features and beautiful underwater lighting that transforms evening entertainment into magical experiences. Adjacent to the pool, an elegant stone and rough cedar cabana provides the perfect setting for relaxation and hosting guests.

The complete outdoor kitchen and bar area creates an entertainer's paradise with full cooking capabilities and comfortable bar seating for casual dining and conversation. A wood-burning fireplace extends the enjoyment year-round, while the full-size refrigerator and ample storage ensure seamless outdoor entertaining. Dedicated outdoor restroom facilities mean guests never need to interrupt their poolside experience, and the professional lighting system creates the perfect ambiance for nighttime gatherings under the East Texas stars.

Workshop &amp; Storage Solutions
Behind the main residence, a metal shop building doubles as a man cave, providing versatile space for hobbies, projects, or recreational activities. The covered parking and storage areas protect valuable equipment investments from East Texas weather while offering flexible spaces that can adapt to various needs, whether for business operations, additional storage, or pursuing personal interests and crafts.
